name: Bricks
description: A paddle-and-ball brick game in a panel, to play while Claude works. Move the paddle with the mouse or arrows; the hit point sets the angle. Strong bricks show their hits left as notches, capsules widen the paddle, slow the ball or add a ball, and five levels repeat faster. Calm, Normal and Fast speeds with a best score each. It pauses on Space, when the pointer leaves the board, when the panel is hidden and when a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, naming that tab with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
author: BronOS
